### Headline summary
- Dropbox is acquiring Tigris Data for $350 million to expand its AI infrastructure. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/dropbox-acquires-tigris-s3-alternative/), [Crunchbase News](https://news.crunchbase.com/ma/dbx-ai-infrastructure-deal-tigris-acquisition/))
- Agility Robotics has become the first dedicated humanoid robotics company to go public in the US via a Nasdaq listing. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/agility-robotics-heads-to-wall-street-tough-road-to-profit-2026-11), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/05/agility-is-the-first-pure-humanoid-robot-company-on-the-stock-market-are-you-buying/))
- Chinese authorities have blocked SoftBank's $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB's robotics unit. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-05/china-blocks-softbank-s-acquisition-of-abb-industrial-robot-unit), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261104/p65#a261104p65))

### Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for AI infrastructure
Dropbox announced plans to acquire Tigris Data for $350 million to bolster its AI infrastructure and support the development of DBX Agent Cloud. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/dropbox-acquires-tigris-s3-alternative/), [Crunchbase News](https://news.crunchbase.com/ma/dbx-ai-infrastructure-deal-tigris-acquisition/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/dropbox-signs-tigris-deal-to-enter-ai-infrastructure/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/05/dropbox-acquires-tigris-data-for-350m-to-bolster-its-ai-iinfrastructure/))

### Agility Robotics begins trading on Nasdaq
Agility Robotics has begun trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker AGLT following a SPAC merger, becoming the first dedicated humanoid robotics company to go public in the US. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/agility-robotics-heads-to-wall-street-tough-road-to-profit-2026-11), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/05/agility-is-the-first-pure-humanoid-robot-company-on-the-stock-market-are-you-buying/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/11/agility-robotics-nasdaq-debut-invites-scrutiny-of-humanoid-robot-market/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261105/p23#a261105p23))

### China blocks SoftBank's ABB robotics acquisition
Chinese authorities have blocked SoftBank Group's $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB's robotics unit, citing concerns over asset exports to Japan. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-05/china-blocks-softbank-s-acquisition-of-abb-industrial-robot-unit), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261104/p65#a261104p65), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/china-blocks-softbanks-5-4-billion-abb-robotics-deal), [Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/china-softbank-abb-robotics-japan-data-ai-investment))

### Cat Wu joins OpenAI from Anthropic
Cat Wu, the product lead for Claude Code at Anthropic, has left the company to join OpenAI to lead product management for its core products. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/cat-wu-joins-openai-from-anthropic-product-lead-coup-2026-11), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261104/p60#a261104p60), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/cat-wu-to-lead-product-management-for-openais-core-products/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-loses-product-lead-catherine-wu-behind-claude-code-to-openai/))

### Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
Meta has acquired Conductor, an AI coding startup that allows developers to control multiple coding agents, in a move to lock in developers. ([Silicon RepublicSilicon Republic](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/business/meta-acquires-ai-coding-start-up-conductor), [Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/meta-buys-ai-coding-startup-conductor), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/meta-buys-ai-coding-startup-conductor-as-big-tech-races-to-lock-in-developers/))

### Zipline raises $1.5B for US drone network
Autonomous drone delivery startup Zipline raised $1.5 billion at a $21.5 billion valuation to expand its manufacturing and build a US drone network. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/zipline-raises-1-5b-at-21-5b-valuation-to-build-us-drone-network/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261105/p28#a261105p28))

### OpenAI pipeline finds Linux kernel flaws
OpenAI reported that a prototype pipeline using an upcoming cyber model identified and validated 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/openai-pipeline-finds-948-linux-kernel-privilege-escalation-flaws/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261104/p62#a261104p62))

### Google AI Research Staff Concerns Over Contract Clauses and Public Communication
Google AI researchers and staffers report that contract clauses are silencing them from warning the public about AI risks, with some calling for the removal of these restrictive terms. ([Hacker News (AI tag)](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/04/google-says-k-12-students-at-schools-that-turn-off-its-ai-tools-will-lose-google-search/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/google-deepmind-employees-contract-ai-criticism-3809352), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/google-deepmind-workers-silenced-censorship-ai))
